title: Reovirus Viral Purification
author: Bernardo Mainou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vj7e4rn
materials: Wipe bottom of tube with ethanol.

steps.title: Pellet L929 Cells
steps.instruction: Pellet 4x10^8 spinner-adapted L929 cells at 2000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant (note: this can be added back to a 1 L bottle for use during infection).

steps.title: Adsorb Virus to Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in a total volume of 40 mL of virus in Joklik’s Minimum Essential Media without supplements (JMEM).

substeps.instruction: Adsorb for 1 hour at room temperature using passage 2 or viral prep supernatant at an MOI of 10 PFU/cell with gentle shaking on an orbital shaker.

steps.title: Initiate Viral Infection
steps.instruction: Add the adsorption mixture to 760 mL of JMEM supplemented with 5% FBS, 2mM L-Glutamine, 100 U penicillin per ml, 100 ug streptomycin per ml, and 0.25 mg per ml amphotericin B.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on a spinner plate at 34 °C - 37 °C with environmental CO2 for 72 hours.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Spin the culture at 2500 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store Cells
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in 7 mL of HO buffer.

substeps.instruction: If using immediately, perform one freeze/thaw cycle.
Note: Supernatants of infections started with passage 2 reovirus can be stored at 80 °C for future purifications.

steps.title: Lysis and Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 10% DOC per tube and incubate on ice for more than 30 minutes, vortexing every 10 minutes.

steps.title: First Vertrel XF Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first extraction using Vertrel XF and sonication.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate on ice for 1 minute to disrupt cells and place on ice.

steps.title: Second Vertrel XF Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second extraction using Vertrel XF and sonication.

substeps.instruction: Add an additional 2.5 mL of Vertrel XF.
Sonicate on ice for 1 minute to disrupt cells and place on ice.

steps.title: Separate Aqueous Layer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 9700 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous (top) layer to a clean tube and discard the pellets.

steps.title: Third Vertrel XF Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a final extraction on the aqueous layer.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate on ice for 1 minute to disrupt cells and place on ice.

steps.title: Final Extraction Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 9700 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare CsCl Gradient
steps.instruction: Prepare the CsCl gradient during the second centrifugation step.

substeps.instruction: Gently underlay with 2.5 mL of 1.4 g/mL CsCl, ensuring layers do not mix.

steps.title: Load Gradient and Ultracentrifuge
steps.instruction: Carefully layer the aqueous (top) fraction onto the CsCl gradient and balance tubes with HO buffer.

steps.title: Collect Virus Fractions
steps.instruction: Puncture the bottom of the tube with an 18.5-gauge needle.

substeps.instruction: Collect the virus fraction (bottom band) and top-component (top band) into a clean tube.

steps.title: Dialyze Virus
steps.instruction: Dialyze exhaustively against 400 mL - 500 mL of cold dialysis buffer for at least 24 hours at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Change the buffer after 1 hour, 4 hours, and the next morning.

steps.title: Final Processing and Storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the purified virus to a new tube.

substeps.instruction: Determine particle density (1 OD260 = 2.1 x 10^12 particles/mL = 185 ug viral protein/mL).
